entities.title: Database migration check
entities.summary: The pull request check main requires: a database change waits for its acknowledgement.
entities.trigger: A pull request opened, edited, pushed to or reopened (migrations.yml).
checks: migration-gate.sh pr: any games/*/worker/schema.sql or worker/migrations/ change, outside .dev, needs an acknowledgement line in the description
notChecked: Whether the migration was in fact applied to production: the gate reads the acknowledgement, not the database.

entities.title: Deploying, by hand
entities.summary: A merge to main deploys nothing; each game is deployed by hand with npm run deploy in its folder.
entities.trigger: The owner, or an agent the owner asks, runs npm run deploy in a game's folder. A push to main starts no workflow since deploy.yml was removed on 2026-11-23.
checks: The game's own npm run deploy: its tests (for most games), its build, then wrangler deploy
notChecked: Database migrations: the migration gate no longer runs before a deploy; whoever deploys checks docs/database-migrations.md first.
No .dev folders in dist/: only game.yml checks that, on the pull request.
secrets: A Cloudflare API token for the icelander.net account, on the machine that deploys
